channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-135721 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ff_rtp_send_vc2hq() in libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c that accepts a Dirac next parse offset of zero. Attackers can supply crafted Dirac/VC-2 video remuxed to the RTP muxer, causing the parsing pointer to never advance and consume CPU indefinitely.

item.title: CVE-2026-135722 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in peak_init_writer() and wav_write_packet() in libavformat/wavenc.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying audio with zero channels. Attackers can provide a crafted PCM stream declaring no channels for WAV output with peak envelope enabled, causing out-of-bounds writes past peak_maxpos and peak_maxneg arrays, crashes, and potential code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-135723 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a double free vulnerability in the fill_marker() function of libavformat/imf_cpl.c that frees a Marker label without clearing the pointer when default scope allocation fails. Attackers can supply a crafted Composition Playlist with a Marker Label lacking a scope attribute, triggering a second free in imf_marker_free() under memory pressure and causing memory corruption or a crash.

item.title: CVE-2026-135724 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in avformat_stream_group_create() in libavformat/options.c that sets the group type before allocating parameters. Attackers can supply crafted HEIF/AVIF files whose tile grid parsing under allocation failure makes ff_free_stream_group() dereference a NULL tile_grid, crashing the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-135725 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ff_rtmp_packet_write() in libavformat/rtmppkt.c that allows malicious RTMP servers to overflow a 16-byte header buffer. Attackers can send a Set Chunk Size packet on a high channel id with an extended timestamp, which handle_chunk_size() echoes back, corrupting the publishing client's stack.

item.title: CVE-2026-135726 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in rdt_parse_packet() in libavformat/rdt.c that allows remote attackers to crash applications by omitting the ASMRuleBook SDP attribute. Attackers can serve an RTSP session selecting RDT transport without ASMRuleBook, then send an RDT data packet to crash ffmpeg or ffprobe.

item.title: CVE-2026-135727 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in rfc4175_handle_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_rfc4175.c that leaks heap contents into decoded video frames. Attackers can send RTP streams containing only some scan lines of a frame, leaving av_malloc buffer bytes uninitialized and exposing process heap memory in displayed, stored or re-streamed video.

item.title: CVE-2026-135728 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a signed integer overflow vulnerability in libavformat/dashdec.c that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a crafted DASH manifest. Attackers can craft an MPD manifest with very long BaseURL and SegmentTemplate strings to overflow max_url_size, causing undersized URL allocations and denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-135729 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an XML injection vulnerability in write_adaptation_set() in libavformat/webmdashenc.c that writes stream language metadata unescaped into the AdaptationSet lang attribute. Attackers can supply crafted WebM files whose track language contains quotes or angle brackets to inject attributes or elements, controlling segment URLs and representations in generated MPD manifests.

item.title: CVE-2026-135730 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory vulnerability in vpk_read_header() in libavformat/vpk.c that computes a last block size not divisible by the channel count. Attackers can supply a crafted VPK file with a large channel count so the last audio packet exposes leftover heap memory contents.

item.title: CVE-2026-135731 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an integer overflow in send_picture() of libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c that leaves the bit reader without a buffer, causing a NULL pointer dereference. Attackers can supply a Dirac/VC-2 stream with a picture data unit of about 256 MiB or more to crash applications packetizing it to RTP.

item.title: CVE-2026-135732 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in mxf_write_d10_audio_packet() in libavformat/mxfenc.c because mxf_init() accepts unsupported D-10 audio codecs. Attackers can supply a crafted input with a non-PCM multichannel audio stream remuxed to D-10 MXF to leak heap memory into the output file or crash the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-135733 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | FFmpeg through 9.1 contains an insecure default configuration in the zmq and azmq filters of libavfilter/f_zmq.c that binds an unauthenticated command socket to all interfaces on TCP port 5555. Remote attackers can send 'TARGET COMMAND [ARG]' messages passed to avfilter_graph_send_command() to change filter runtime parameters and alter processed audio or video.

item.title: CVE-2026-135734 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the deflicker filter that lets attackers corrupt heap memory via unclamped high bit depth luma samples. Attackers can supply crafted video whose luma values exceed the nominal depth, making calc_avgy16() increment counters past the histogram allocation, causing crashes or possibly code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-135735 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in filter_slice_rgba_planar() that allows attackers to read beyond lookup tables using unmasked high bit depth planar samples. Attackers can supply crafted video with samples exceeding the nominal depth, passed unchanged by rawvideo, to crash the application or leak heap contents into output video.

item.title: CVE-2026-135736 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | FFmpeg 4.4 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_deband.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending a runtime coupling command. Attackers can send a 'deband coupling 1' command via sendcmd or an unauthenticated zmq filter, making chroma planes be processed at luma dimensions to crash the process or potentially execute code.

item.title: CVE-2026-135737 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write and read vulnerability in the tmidequalizer filter that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal maximum. Attackers can craft planar 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit video so compute_histogram16() and apply_contrast_change16() index unclamped samples, crashing applications, corrupting the heap, and leaking heap contents.

item.title: CVE-2026-135738 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_signalstats.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal maximum. Attackers can craft planar 9 to 14 bit YUV video whose unclamped samples or saturation values index past histogram ends, crashing applications or possibly executing code.

item.title: CVE-2026-135739 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_scale.c that allows attackers to read past the filter input array by sending width or height commands using ref variables. Attackers can send such commands via sendcmd scripts or unauthenticated zmq or azmq filters, causing config_props() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-135740 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_readeia608.c because build_histogram() does not clamp high bit depth luma samples to the nominal maximum. Attackers can supply crafted 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit gray or YUV video to corrupt heap memory, causing crashes or possibly code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-135741 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_lut2.c because the second input's pixel format is unrestricted when the output depth option is set. Attackers can supply crafted media such as monoblack BMP or PBM images to index beyond lookup tables, crashing applications or leaking heap contents into output video.

item.title: CVE-2026-135742 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in recv_msg() of the zmq and azmq filters that allows unauthenticated network attackers to corrupt memory by sending oversized command messages. Attackers can send a 4 GiB message to the default listening port, truncating the int buffer size so memcpy() writes past the heap allocation and crashes FFmpeg.

item.title: CVE-2026-135743 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | FFmpeg 4.3 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in the dynaudnorm filter because cqueue_resize() miscalculates gain history queue element counts when gausssize changes at runtime. Attackers can send gausssize commands via asendcmd scripts or an unauthenticated azmq filter to corrupt heap memory, crashing the process or potentially executing code.

item.title: CVE-2026-135744 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the lut1d filter in libavfilter/vf_lut3d.c that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying planar high bit depth samples above the nominal depth. Attackers can craft 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit planar RGB video processed with a large 1D LUT to crash applications or disclose heap contents in output pixels.

item.title: CVE-2026-135745 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the curves filter in libavfilter/vf_curves.c that allows attackers to read past lookup tables by supplying planar high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal depth. item.title: CVE-2026-135457 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A security flaw has been discovered in amirhamza05 Student-Management-System up to 449397e35d42e3779f14f0bfc654ab307103f7e3. item.title: CVE-2026-135202 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8 | Several plugins for WordPress published by WP connect (Orders Sync to Airtable for WooCommerce, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Notion, WP Sync for Notion – Notion to WordPress, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Airtable, Add-on Brevo for Gravity Forms, and Air WP Sync – Airtable to WordPress) contain embedded malicious code (a backdoor) in the versions listed. The affected releases unconditionally load a backdoor module (includes/airwp-online.php) that runs on every request via the 'init' hook and on a half-hourly WP-Cron event, sends site information (site URL, PHP, WordPress and OS versions, and the server user) to a remote command-and-control server at tascredit-pay.com with TLS certificate verification disabled, and executes the PHP code returned by that server via eval(). The module also accepts queued commands that run shell commands, read, write and delete arbitrary files, query arbitrary database tables, dump the users table including password hashes, drop a webshell into the uploads directory, and install persistent hourly code execution. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers in control of the remote server, or able to intercept its traffic, to execute arbitrary code on the server and fully compromise affected sites. All affected plugins have been closed on WordPress.org and no patched versions are available; we strongly recommend uninstalling them and running a complete malware scan.
